<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BuildingAHouse"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/building-a-house">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Requirements" name="Tree house requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RefinedPlan" name="Refined plan"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Draft" name="Tree house draft"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BuildingAHouse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_You" name="You" processRef="Process_BuildingAHouse"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Architect" name="Tree house architect"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Requirements" name="Send requirements"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect"
                      messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialDraft" name="Return draft"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Architect" targetRef="Event_CatchInitialDraft"
                      messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RefinedPlan" name="Send refined plan"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendRefinedPlan" targetRef="Participant_Architect"
                      messageRef="Message_RefinedPlan"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_UpdatedDraft" name="Return updated draft"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Architect" targetRef="Event_CatchUpdatedDraft"
                      messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BuildingAHouse" name="Building a House" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_BuildingAHouse">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_You" name="You">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_BuildingAHouse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CatchInitialDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RefineDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MoreRefinement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRefinedPlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CatchUpdatedDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateMaterialsList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelWorkSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitOrderProcessing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MessageFriendsToBuild</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelWorkJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuildHouse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendPartyInvitations</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateAttendeeList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_AttendeeListCreated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BuildingAHouse" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to the tree house architect"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchInitialDraft" name="Receive draft from the architect">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_InitialDraft" messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefineDraft" name="Refine draft with additional requirements"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreRefinement" name="More refinement needed?" default="Flow_NoMoreRefinement"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendRefinedPlan" name="Send refined plan to the architect"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchUpdatedDraft" name="Receive updated draft from the architect">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_UpdatedDraft" messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialsList" name="Create list of needed materials from the plan"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderMaterials" name="Order materials from several online stores"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelWorkSplit" name=""/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitOrderProcessing" name="Wait for material order to be processed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MessageFriendsToBuild" name="Send messages to friends to build the house"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelWorkJoin" name=""/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildHouse" name="Build the house"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendPartyInvitations" name="Send tree house party invitations to friends"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create list of people attending the party"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AttendeeListCreated" name="Attendee list created"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Collect" sourceRef="Start_BuildingAHouse" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_SendRequirements" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendRequirements_InitialDraft" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Event_CatchInitialDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialDraft_Refine" sourceRef="Event_CatchInitialDraft" targetRef="Task_RefineDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine_Decision" sourceRef="Task_RefineDraft" targetRef="Gateway_MoreRefinement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoreRefinement_Send" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreRefinement" targetRef="Task_SendRefinedPlan">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${moreRefinementsNeeded}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendRefinedPlan_UpdatedDraft" sourceRef="Task_SendRefinedPlan" targetRef="Event_CatchUpdatedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdatedDraft_Refine" sourceRef="Event_CatchUpdatedDraft" targetRef="Task_RefineDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoMoreRefinement" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreRefinement" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateList_Order" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList" targetRef="Task_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Wait" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_WaitOrderProcessing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_MessageFriends" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_MessageFriendsToBuild"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Join" sourceRef="Task_WaitOrderProcessing" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MessageFriends_Join" sourceRef="Task_MessageFriendsToBuild" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Build" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkJoin" targetRef="Task_BuildHouse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Invitations" sourceRef="Task_BuildHouse" targetRef="Task_SendPartyInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invitations_AttendeeList" sourceRef="Task_SendPartyInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AttendeeList_End" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="End_AttendeeListCreated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
